journey.title: Think First! 💭
journey.studentText: When we add 38 + 25, we first add the ones: 8 + 5 = 13. That's 1 ten and 3 ones. We carry the 1 ten!
journey.owlText: Take a moment to think about adding two 2-digit numbers with regrouping. What do you already know? There's no wrong answer!
